'''Makatak''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Rakatan Archipelago]]. Following the collapse of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], it was inhabited by an enlightened tribe of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] called the [[Makatak tribe]].
